official_definition: Resonance: XX(/YY) (When Attacks) You can reveal a card from your decktop. If that card is "XX"(/"YY")-named, you can summon/deploy it without paying the cost. Discard any remaining card.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Resonance] or [Resonance: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Resonance]", "give [Resonance]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
